Question
========
What does completeness refer to?

Answerlist
----------
* absence of duplicate values
* whether all required data values are present
* whether metadata is present
* whether datasets have certain number of rows and columns


Solution
========
Completeness refers to whether all required data values are present.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
